question: What Na content did ion chromatography find in the original sawdust and in the original lignite used for fast co-pyrolysis?
trap: the 0.79 wt% Na of the loaded sawdust or the 2 wt% NaCl
rendered:
Document: Effects of sodium on nitrogen evolution characteristics during the fast co-pyrolysis of coal and biomass, page 2

The Na content in the raw materials was quantified using ion chromatography (IC, DIONEX AQ-1100), yielding 0.27% for SD-original and 2.75% for LC-original.
